description.value: European Butcher Boy is a European-style deli and butcher shop operated by European Butcher Boy Ltd. It offers a specialty food stop for cyclists looking for deli products and prepared provisions along the Edmonds Street corridor. As a neighbourhood deli, it may carry cured meats, cheeses, and other European specialty items suited to stocking up for a tour.
